jobs.description:
Labs Strategy and Operations Program Specialist (Milpitas, CA)This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

HPE Labs is seeking an energetic and highly adaptable ***early-career professional***to join the Operations and Outreach team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across a variety of projects, learning new disciplines quickly, and helping teams turn ideas into action. As a Strategy and Operations Program Specialist, you will partner with leaders across HPE Labs and the Office of the CTO to coordinate strategic initiatives, support government-funded opportunities, help execute key events and engagements, and drive operational excellence across the organization.

  

No two weeks are alike! You may be helping coordinate a proposal submission for a federal research opportunity, supporting planning for a major industry event, tracking deliverables for an executive initiative, or helping organize a customer or stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires curiosity, organization, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively across a wide range of teams and topics.

**What You'll Do**

**Strategic Programs & Operations**

* Support planning and execution of strategic initiatives sponsored by HPE Labs leadership
* Coordinate cross-functional projects and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Help establish processes that improve visibility, accountability, and organizational effectiveness
* Develop project updates, reports, briefing materials, and leadership communications
* Support staff meetings, leadership reviews, action tracking, and follow-up activities

**Government Proposals & Contracts**

* Support proposal development and submission activities for U.S. Government-funded opportunities
* Coordinate schedules, requirements, reviews, and stakeholder inputs across multiple teams
* Track proposal milestones, deliverables, and compliance activities
* Assist with lifecycle management of funded programs and related reporting requirements

**Events & External Engagement**

* Support HPE Labs participation in conferences, customer events, executive briefings, and innovation showcases
* Coordinate timelines, logistics, stakeholder communications, and event deliverables
* Help manage planning activities associated with demonstrations, presentations, and executive engagements
* Work with internal partners to ensure successful event execution and follow-through

**Executive & Special Projects**

* Conduct research and analysis to support strategic decision-making
* Support special projects led by HPE Labs and OCTO leadership
* Help drive execution of high-priority initiatives requiring coordination across multiple organizations
* Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and team collaboration

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or a related field
* 3-5 years of professional experience including project coordination or project-based work experience
* Technical skills and experience using Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, Power BI, AI tools and similar business applications
* Strong organizational and project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
* Comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders across technical and business functions
* Strong problem-solving skills with ability to quickly learn new tools, processes, and business domains
* Self-motivated and resourceful, with the ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Weave (YC W25) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration.

Trusted by 200+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double-digit month-over-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth.

As Weave's Customer Success Manager, you'll own everything that happens after a customer signs. You'll get customers live fast, turn Weave into a weekly habit for their engineering managers, and make sure every account renews and grows.

We've raised a $13.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, Y Combinator, Moonfire, Burst Capital, IrregEx and the Agent Fund.

This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work.

**WHAT WE'RE BUILDING**
-----------------------

Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles.

We use AI to:

* Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship)
* Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact
* Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance

Today that means two products: the Weave platform, which shows engineering leaders how AI is changing their team's output, quality and token spend, and the open-source Weave Router, which routes each coding-agent prompt to the right model based on cost, speed and quality.

**THE TEAM YOU'LL WORK WITH**
-----------------------------

You'll work directly with:

* Adam (CEO): leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high-growth startups who has scaled multiple sales teams from $0 to $30M in ARR, and he stays deeply embedded with customers.
* Andrew (CTO): previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew is deeply committed to mentorship and ownership for everyone on the team, and will be your closest partner on getting more technical fast.

You'll also work side by side with our sales team and engineers every day.

This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one.

**THE ROLE**
------------

This isn't a traditional customer success role. You'll be as comfortable debugging an integration as you are running a renewal call. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of account manager, solutions engineer and data analyst.

Every customer buys Weave to answer some version of the same question: "is AI actually making our engineering team better, and is it worth what we're spending?" Your job is to make sure they get an answer they trust, and then act on it.

You'll own a book of our largest accounts from kickoff to renewal, from fast-growing startups to public companies like Robinhood. You'll also build the onboarding and automation that covers every other customer. You'll be measured on whether customers stay, whether usage spreads from the leader who bought Weave to the managers who run their teams with it every week, and whether accounts grow.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* **Get customers live fast.** Run onboarding end to end, from connecting GitHub and AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor to their first executive report.
* **Drive adoption past the buyer.** Train engineering managers and tech leads until Weave is part of their 1:1s, sprint reviews and planning.
* **Be the expert on the data.** Help customers read their metrics, run business reviews on what changed, and dig in when a number looks wrong.
* **Own renewals and expansion.** Track account health, find the next champion when one leaves, and partner with sales to grow accounts.
* **Close the loop with engineering.** Triage and reproduce issues, write bug reports engineers can act on, and bring customer patterns back to the roadmap.
* **Build the playbook.** Onboarding checklists, health scores and help docs, automated wherever possible.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

### **MUST-HAVE**

* 2+ years in a post-sale, customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company: customer success, account management, implementation, solutions or support.
* You've owned a book of business. You were measured on renewals, retention or expansion, and you can walk us through your numbers and the accounts you saved.
* You're technical enough to unblock customers. You don't need to have been an engineer, but you know how software teams ship (PRs, code review, CI/CD, incidents), you're at home in GitHub, and when an integration breaks, you dig in before you escalate.
* You use AI tools every day. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar are part of how you work, and you have real opinions about what they're good at.
* You write and speak clearly. You can walk a CTO through a messy dataset in a few minutes, and write the follow-up that gets everyone aligned.
* Self-starter who's comfortable in ambiguity and wired for speed.
* This role is 5 days in office in SF

### **NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Hands-on technical experience. You've worked as a software engineer, support engineer, solutions engineer or forward deployed engineer, or you've shipped code as part of your job.
* You can write SQL or a quick Python script to answer your own questions.
* Customer success experience at a developer tools, data or AI company where your users were engineers
* Real opinions on DORA, SPACE and DevEx, and on what changes when agents write half the code
* You've built customer success from zero: onboarding programs, health scores, QBR templates, help docs
* Experience at an early-stage startup (Seed to Series B)

**WHY JOIN**
------------

* $120K-$150K base salary + early equity
* Health/vision/dental insurance covered
* Free lunch/dinners/snacks
* Yearly team offsite with regular team events
* Yearly $500 learning/develo

jobs.title: Office Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Operations Manager**

**Family-Owned Business | Established 1961**

**About Us**

Founded in 1961, we are a family-owned business built on long-term relationships with our employees and customers. We operate as a small, interdependent team where everyone contributes, takes ownership, and makes a meaningful impact.

We value accuracy, accountability, initiative, and people who take pride in doing things right the first time.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on Office Operations Manager position for an experienced, detail-oriented professional who understands the day-to-day financial and operational processes that keep a business running.

Our office moves quickly. Priorities shift, requests come from multiple directions, and accuracy and follow-through are essential. We need someone who can step into the role with a strong working knowledge of QuickBooks and practical experience managing the full cycle of purchasing, inventory, customer orders, invoicing, and payments.

**This is not an entry-level accounting or administrative position.** We are looking for someone who has performed these functions in a business setting, understands how the steps connect, and can manage routine transactions independently with minimal training.

You will own core financial and operational processes while serving as a central point of support for the office and the broader team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Receivable & Order Processing**

* Enter and process customer orders accurately.
* Prepare shipping documents and coordinate order fulfillment.
* Generate customer invoices based on completed orders and shipping documentation.
* Post customer payments and reconcile payment records as needed.
* Prepare bank deposits and assist with collections and overdue accounts.
* Maintain accurate customer records and resolve routine billing discrepancies.

**Accounts Payable & Purchasing**

* Create and issue purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Receive and process inventory against purchase orders and supporting documentation.
* Enter vendor invoices into QuickBooks, verifying amounts, quantities, pricing, and supporting records.
* Track invoice due dates and manage payment schedules.
* Prepare and process vendor payments in accordance with company procedures.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, receipts, and vendor invoices.

**Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate inventory records and perform routine inventory checks.
* Track customer-owned inventory separately and maintain reliable records of quantities and movements.
* Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies in coordination with the team.

**QuickBooks & Financial Recordkeeping**

* Use QuickBooks confidently to enter transactions, maintain accurate records, and retrieve financial information.
* Understand how purchasing, inventory, accounts payable, customer orders, accounts receivable, and payments connect.
* Review work for accuracy and completeness and identify inconsistencies before they become larger problems.
* Maintain organized documentation and records to support accurate financial reporting.

**Office Operations & Team Support**

* Answer incoming calls, manage email, and respond professionally to customers and vendors.
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems.
* Conduct internet research and handle administrative projects and requests.
* Manage competing priorities, communicate when deadlines conflict, and follow tasks through to completion.
* Provide practical support to colleagues as business needs change.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Demonstrated, hands-on QuickBooks experience** in a business environment, including entering transactions and managing accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Practical understanding of the complete purchasing cycle, from creating a purchase order through receiving goods, processing the vendor invoice, and arranging payment.
* Practical understanding of the customer order-to-cash cycle, from order entry and shipping documentation through invoicing and posting customer payments.
* Experience maintaining accurate inventory and financial records.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
* A customer-service mindset and the ability to work effectively with customers, vendors, and colleagues.
* Initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and consistent follow-through.

**The Right Fit**

The successful candidate is someone who:

* Can explain how routine accounting and purchasing transactions flow through a business, rather than simply following isolated instructions.
* Has performed the responsibilities described above and can provide concrete examples of their experience.
* Recognizes discrepancies, asks appropriate questions, and takes ownership of resolving routine issues.
* Learns company-specific procedures quickly without needing extensive instruction on basic accounting workflows or software functions.
* Is comfortable in a small office where everyone contributes, priorities can change, and reliability matters.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Join Our Team!

**Full-Time | Four-Day Workweek | Fridays Off!**

Are you a friendly, positive, organized person who genuinely enjoys helping others? Do you take pride in doing your job well, following through on responsibilities, and making people feel welcome?

At **Canyon Chiropractic & SF Bay Wellness**, we're looking for an exceptional **Patient Experience Coordinator** to join our team!

We're not simply looking for someone to answer phones and schedule appointments. We're looking for someone who wants to make a difference in people's lives, takes ownership of their responsibilities, and enjoys being part of a team that works together to provide an outstanding patient experience.

Our team of doctors and staff is passionate about helping people improve their health and quality of life. We want someone who shares that enthusiasm.

**No previous chiropractic or medical experience is required.** We're happy to train the right person who brings a great attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Patient Experience Coordinator, you'll play an important role in making sure our patients have an exceptional experience from the moment they contact our office.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Greeting patients warmly and making them feel welcome.
* Answering incoming phone calls professionally and enthusiastically.
* Scheduling appointments and managing patient schedules.
* Checking patients in and out efficiently.
* Following up with patients regarding missed appointments, scheduling, and other needs.
* Maintaining accurate patient information and office records.
* Communicating effectively with our doctors and team members.
* Staying organized and keeping up with responsibilities in a busy office.
* Helping identify ways to improve office efficiency and the patient experience.
* Taking initiative and following through on tasks without needing constant reminders.

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Has a friendly, outgoing, and positive personality.
* Genuinely enjoys interacting with people and helping others.

jobs.description:
**ETTIKA | Fashion Jewelry & Accessories**

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid preferred; remote considered for experienced candidates)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + performance-based commission, based on experience

About Ettika

Ettika is a Los Angeles-based fashion jewelry and accessories brand known for trend-forward designs, affordable luxury, and a strong presence across major retailers and independent boutiques nationwide.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, results-driven **Boutique Wholesale Sales & Account Manager** to help build, manage, and expand our independent boutique wholesale division across the United States.

This is a hands-on sales and business development role for someone who enjoys building relationships, opening new accounts, and creating long-term revenue opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**Wholesale Sales & Boutique Development**

* Identify, prospect, and onboard new independent boutiques and specialty retailers across the USA.
* Build and maintain relationships with boutique owners, buyers, and purchasing teams.
* Grow wholesale revenue through new account acquisition, reorders, and account development.
* Develop targeted outreach strategies through email, phone, virtual appointments, and industry networking.
* Present new collections, seasonal assortments, and best-selling products to boutique buyers.
* Establish a consistent sales pipeline and follow-up process to convert prospects into active accounts.

**Wholesale Platforms & Dropshipping**

* Manage and grow Ettika's presence on Faire, including new customer acquisition, account relationships, and reorders.
* Support and potentially expand wholesale sales through NuORDER.
* Introduce and onboard eligible boutiques to Shopify Collective, allowing them to sell Ettika products through a dropshipping model.
* Educate retail partners on traditional wholesale purchasing versus dropshipping opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure accurate product listings, pricing, inventory availability, and fulfillment.

**Account Management & Growth**

* Maintain ongoing communication with boutique partners to encourage repeat purchases.
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to increase sales.
* Develop seasonal sales campaigns, promotions, and new collection launches.
* Track wholesale leads, sales activity, conversion rates, and revenue performance.
* Collaborate with Ettika's merchandising, marketing, and operations teams to support boutique partners.
* Help establish scalable processes for managing a growing national boutique network.

Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience in wholesale sales, boutique account management, or business development, preferably in fashion jewelry, accessories, apparel, or lifestyle products.
* Existing relationships with independent boutiques and specialty retailers are highly desirable.
* Experience selling through Faire or similar B2B wholesale marketplaces.
* Familiarity with NuORDER, Shopify Collective, or dropshipping platforms is a plus.
* Strong communication, negotiation, prospecting, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable managing a sales pipeline independently and working toward measurable revenue targets.
* Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple accounts and opportunities.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistently opening new, qualified boutique accounts nationwide.
* Increasing wholesale orders and repeat purchase frequency.
* Growing revenue through Faire and other wholesale channels.
* Successfully onboarding boutiques to Shopify Collective.
* Building a scalable, profitable boutique wholesale division with measurable monthly growth.

Why Join Ettika?

You'll have the opportunity to help shape and grow an established fashion accessories brand's boutique wholesale business. This role offers meaningful ownership, direct collaboration with leadership, and performance-based earning potential.

**To Apply:**

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your wholesale boutique sales experience, platforms you've worked with, and any existing boutique relationships or networks you bring to the role.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have managing wholesale sales to independent boutiques?
* Do you have existing relationships with boutique owners or buyers across the USA?
* Which wholesale platforms have you personally managed?

* Briefly describe how you would approach growing Ettika's independent boutique wholesale business nationwide.

jobs.title: HR & People Operations Expert — Remote AI Review
jobs.description:
HR & People Operations Expert — Remote AI Review is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across human resources workflows. Reviewers grade workflow correctness, policy adherence, and stakeholder fit; flag operational risk; and document the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Human resources AI has to fit into an actual day at work. AuraOne uses experienced operators to grade outputs the way a senior peer would — checking workflow, policy, and the unwritten rules that decide whether a task actually gets done.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current human resources workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for HR & People Operations Expert — Remote AI Review assignments.
* Grade tone, escalation logic, and stakeholder fit on a structured rubric.
* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience in human resources on real teams for HR & People Operations Expert — Remote AI Review work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Grade a model's response to a real human resources ticket and rate workflow, tone, and escalation.
* Flag a missed escalation with the right severity tag and corrected next step.
* Adjudicate a disputed playbook call between two reviewers using firm guidance.
* Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Prior experience training, calibrating, or QA-ing operations teams.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflow tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross-region operations.

Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process.

The Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for implementing quality assurance procedures, managing audits, and overseeing compliance with regulations and standards.

Meet the Team
  
  
The Data Center and Internet Infrastructure team is critical in crafting the future of networking and compute solutions for enterprise, hyperscalers, and service provider customers. This team is instrumental in advancing Cisco's critical initiatives, which include modernizing enterprise infrastructure, adopting AI technologies, and redefining service provider networks through innovative architectures and solutions.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Business Operations Manager within the Data Center and Internet Infrastructure (DCII) product organization, you will serve as a key operational strategist and partner. You will work closely with executive leadership to drive the rhythm of the business, streamline operations across the entire DCII organization, and champion initiatives that define our culture and competitive edge. This role requires a blend of operational rigor, strategic communication, and a passion for leveraging emerging technologies to improve organizational efficiency.
  
  

* Central Operational Leadership: Act as an operational partner overseeing core operational cadences, the rhythm of the business, support the measurement of our strategic priorities, and ensure follow-up is rigorously tracked across the entire organization.
* Employee Experience& Onboarding: Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience. This includes designing and managing a best-in-class onboarding program for new hires and leading the organizational internship program to build our pipeline of talent.
* AI Strategy& Advocacy: Support the DCII AI Ambassador program. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities to implement AI tools to optimize workflows, sharing best practices across the organization, and driving AI literacy.
* Executive Communication& Wins: Collaborate with Executive Communications to document, socialize, and celebrate critical customer wins. You will be responsible for maintaining a consistent data collection process regarding our customer impact and success in the market.
* Strategic Initiatives: Lead high-impact, cross-functional projects that require complex stakeholder management and drive toward measurable business outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in high-tech business operations, chief of staff roles, program management, or a similar function.
* Experience with the Microsoft Office (such as SharePoint, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Experience using AI platforms such as Codex, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, ChatGBT
* Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or equivalent relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Demonstrated experience using AI tools for business productivity and a strong desire to stay at the forefront of AI innovation.
* Expertise in managing end-to-end programs, from planning and cross-functional alignment through execution, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify operational bottlenecks and proactively implement scalable solutions.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills; ability to synthesize complex information into compelling narratives for executive audiences.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
